description: Issue #35 part 4V, lesson 04-26 (docs/part04v/04-26-display-files.md). COMPILE-ONLY (V1): screens cannot be run non-interactively (EXFMT would hang), so NO program is CALLed. Compiles the display files D0426A (= r0411s.dspf, byte copy), D0426B (load-all subfile, no DDS conditioning indicators), the exercise-answer DSPFs D0426D/D0426E and two probe DSPFs (D0426P: SFLCLR/SFLDSP/SFLEND conditioned by indicators 70-72, cols 8-10; D0426Q: a constant conditioned by indicator 50), then the fixed-form RPG IV programs V0426A (port of R0411A) and V0426B (SFILE(SFL1:RRN) subfile load), exercise answers V0426C/D/E, and four NEGATIVE sources whose real RNF/RNS message ids go into the lesson: V0426X1 (WORKSTN col 18 blank + EXFMT), V0426X2 (WRITE SFL1 without SFILE), V0426X3 (RRN not declared), V0426X4 (two conditioning indicators on one C line). RPG compile events (EVFEVENT, severity + message ids) are copied to VFYEV26 and selected; DSPF compiles (CRTDSPF without *EVENTF, no precedent) are read from the job log (VFYLOG). Expected: D0426A/B/D/E/Q severity 00; D0426P unknown (this is the probe); V0426A/B/C/D/E severity 00; V0426X1..X4 fail (ids to record). Manual 5250 steps (V3) stay in the lesson.

steps.label: LIBFIX
steps.cmd:
RMVLIBLE LIB(&LIB)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)
ADDLIBLE LIB(&LIB) POSITION(*FIRST)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)

CHGPFM FILE(&LIB/QDDSSRC) MBR(D0426A) SRCTYPE(DSPF)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)
CHGPFM FILE(&LIB/QDDSSRC) MBR(D0426B) SRCTYPE(DSPF)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)

MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)
CHGPFM FILE(&LIB/QDDSSRC) MBR(D0426E) SRCTYPE(DSPF)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)
CHGPFM FILE(&LIB/QDDSSRC) MBR(D0426P) SRCTYPE(DSPF)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)
CHGPFM FILE(&LIB/QDDSSRC) MBR(D0426Q) SRCTYPE(DSPF)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)
CHGPFM FILE(&LIB/QRPGLESRC) MBR(V0426A) SRCTYPE(RPGLE)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)
CHGPFM FILE(&LIB/QRPGLESRC) MBR(V0426B) SRCTYPE(RPGLE)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)
CHGPFM FILE(&LIB/QRPGLESRC) MBR(V0426C) SRCTYPE(RPGLE)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)

MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)
CHGPFM FILE(&LIB/QRPGLESRC) MBR(V0426E) SRCTYPE(RPGLE)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)
CHGPFM FILE(&LIB/QRPGLESRC) MBR(V0426X1) SRCTYPE(RPGLE)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)
CHGPFM FILE(&LIB/QRPGLESRC) MBR(V0426X2) SRCTYPE(RPGLE)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)
CHGPFM FILE(&LIB/QRPGLESRC) MBR(V0426X3) SRCTYPE(RPGLE)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)
CHGPFM FILE(&LIB/QRPGLESRC) MBR(V0426X4) SRCTYPE(RPGLE)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)

steps.label: EVFPF
steps.cmd:
CHKOBJ OBJ(&LIB/VFYEV26) OBJTYPE(*FILE)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF9801) EXEC(CRTPF FILE(&LIB/VFYEV26) RCDLEN(300) TEXT('04-26 compile event capture'))

steps.label: EVV0426A
